steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Hmm, it's kind of useful. Makes good insurance.
She's placidly getting rid of the filthy and wounded enemies, looking calm as if the shackles have no restrictive effect on her at all.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That's what an S-Class Sinner is like...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, are you alright? Are you having any side effects from using the shackles on her?
Hecate hasn't left your side since, and her overly nervous look somehow lessens your anxiety.
I've never heard you need to take special precautions to use the shackles on S-Class Sinners. As the leader, it's our gain to have caught this big fish.
We're outnumbered now, but I'm sure we'll find a chance later. We'll come up with a way to get out of this...
What way?
The lanky advisor of the Legion suddenly emerges behind you.

steps.speaker: Legion Advisor
steps.content: Glad to see you're unharmed, our guests from Minos. Relax, I'm not here to kill anyone.

steps.speaker: Legion Advisor
steps.content: I'm <color=#fb9259>Earl</color>, the Legion's advisor. I'm here to sincerely ask for your cooperation.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: The purpose of the Legion's current mission is to seize the trophy that should have belonged to us. That is, to retrieve the inheritance in the cave. I believe you understand that this is the gang's internal affair and it doesn't violate the Management Regulations.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: We never intend to go against the authorities, we only need the Chief's assistance. As for our commander's temper... I beg your forgiveness.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: The Legion will soon unify Syndicate. It's crucial for us to build a healthy relationship with the authorities early on.
He holds out a hand to you, but you don't take it.
Sensing vigilance in the two Sinners beside you, an alarm is sounding in your mind.

options: Was it you who called Zoya?
Was it you who separately interrogate them?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...Yes.
This man has an intricate mind. He'll only look for partnership from someone who can benefit them. Now that you've already put the shackles on Zoya, he must be seeking compensation in other ways.
Seeing no response from you, he smiles and draws back his neglected hand.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...I don't like dancing around the subject with the smart ones either, let me get to the point then.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: I'm the second Sinner of the Legion, and my ability is precise explosion. While you were unconscious, I've already implanted a bomb inside your body.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Hold back your power, kid. Unless you want to see his head blow up right now.
steps.female_content: Hold back your power, kid. Unless you want to see her head blow up right now.

options: This is the insurance you've taken for this partnership?
You don't approve of this cooperation at all.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: After all, your shackles are too powerful. I hope the partnership is established with both parties on equal grounds.
This idea of equality sounds laughable.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Yes. But since the commander has chosen you, I must make sure her decision will turn out flawless.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Rest assured. As long as the commander still needs your shackles, I'll let you live till the end.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: If you ever use the Forbidden Force on my commander, threaten her, or confine her... or if she were to die for any reason, I'll detonate the bomb immediately.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Once the mission ends successfully, I'll remove my power over you.
He turns to leave, the metallic prosthetic in place of his left leg clanging.
He's not going to let you live till the end or allow you to threaten the Legion. Once the mission ends, the bomb will go off so that their commander can have her freedom back.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait!
Having been unusually silent, Hella suddenly comes forward. Ever since you've been reunited, she's been seeming troubled, as if searching for something.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That girl with the motorbike... She's not with you guys, is she? The Legion only hired her to hunt us down, right?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Where... did she go?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: She's finished her job. She's left.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Left? That's not possible, she was here to find me! She couldn't just leave without a wo —

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Why don't you ask her yourself then? Are the shackles on you stopping you from doing that too?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Let's go down, they've waited long enough.

Beneath the crypt, the ominous pulsations are still continuing. The gangsters are growing uneasy. They've obviously received the signals sent by the sentries, and the grand battle is ready to break out any moment now.

You've been dragged into this dogfight that you have nothing to do with. From now on, either trying to get yourself out of this situation or continuing with your mission will put you in a precarious position.
